description: Flat metadata schema for individual biosynthetic gene cluster records from soil-derived bacterial genome analyses, including isolate provenance, genome context, cluster coordinates, gene annotations, and chemical/antibiotic characterization.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for this metadata record (one record per biosynthetic gene cluster / linked antibiotic discovery unit). Example: 'BGC_000123'.

strain_id.descr: Unique identifier for the bacterial isolate/strain from which the genome was obtained. Example: 'SB-17'.

isolate_name.descr: Human-readable isolate name or label used in the laboratory. Example: 'Streptomyces sp. S4'.

soil_sample_id.descr: Identifier for the originating soil sample. Example: 'SOIL_2024_05_A'.

soil_sample_site.descr: Location or site name where the soil sample was collected. Example: 'temperate forest plot 3'.

soil_sampling_date.descr: Date when the soil sample was collected, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

soil_depth_cm.descr: Depth of soil collection in centimeters, if known. Example: 10.5 cm.

soil_pH.descr: Measured pH of the soil sample. Example: 6.8.

soil_temperature_c.descr: Temperature of the soil at collection in degrees Celsius, if measured.

soil_moisture_percent.descr: Soil moisture content as a percentage, if measured.

bacterial_taxon.descr: Taxonomic assignment of the isolate at the finest reliable level. Example: 'Streptomyces' or 'Streptomyces sp.'.

taxonomic_method.descr: Method used for taxonomic identification. Example values: '16S rRNA', 'whole-genome ANI', 'MALDI-TOF'.

genome_accession.descr: Public accession or internal identifier for the genome sequence. Example: 'GCF_012345678.1'.

genome_assembly_version.descr: Assembly version or release identifier for the genome. Example: 'v1.2'.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing technology used to generate the genome. Example values: 'Illumina', 'PacBio', 'Oxford Nanopore', 'hybrid'.

sequencing_date.descr: Date of genome sequencing or library run, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD), if available.

library_strategy.descr: Sequencing library strategy or preparation type. Example values: 'paired-end', 'mate-pair', 'long-read', 'hybrid assembly'.

assembly_method.descr: Genome assembly software or pipeline used. Example: 'SPAdes', 'Flye', 'Unicycler'.

assembly_contig_id.descr: Identifier of the contig/scaffold containing the biosynthetic gene cluster.

cluster_id.descr: Unique identifier for the biosynthetic gene cluster within the genome. Example: 'BGC_05'.

cluster_type.descr: Predicted biosynthetic class of the cluster. Example values: 'NRPS', 'PKS', 'NRPS-PKS hybrid', 'terpene', 'RiPP', 'siderophore', 'alkaloid'.

cluster_prediction_tool.descr: Software or pipeline used to predict the biosynthetic gene cluster. Example: 'antiSMASH'.

cluster_prediction_version.descr: Version of the cluster prediction software used. Example: 'antiSMASH 7.0'.

cluster_start_bp.descr: 1-based genomic start coordinate of the cluster on the contig or chromosome, in base pairs.

cluster_end_bp.descr: 1-based genomic end coordinate of the cluster on the contig or chromosome, in base pairs.

cluster_length_bp.descr: Length of the cluster region in base pairs.

cluster_strand.descr: Genomic strand of the cluster. Acceptable values: '+', '-', or 'unknown'.

cluster_gc_percent.descr: GC content of the cluster region expressed as a percentage.

cluster_gene_count.descr: Number of predicted genes within the biosynthetic gene cluster.

cluster_completeness.descr: Assessment of whether the cluster is complete or fragmented. Example values: 'complete', 'partial', 'fragmented'.

cluster_evidence_level.descr: Confidence or evidence level supporting the cluster prediction. Example values: 'predicted', 'curated', 'validated'.

gene_ids.descr: List-like string of gene identifiers belonging to the cluster, separated by a standard delimiter if needed. Example: 'gene1;gene2;gene3'.

gene_annotations.descr: Summary annotation of gene functions within the cluster, potentially using standardized product or enzyme names. Example: 'adenylation enzyme; carrier protein; thioesterase'.

key_biosynthetic_genes.descr: Identifier(s) or names of core biosynthetic genes in the cluster. Example: 'nrpsA; pks1'.

resistance_genes_present.descr: Indicates whether self-resistance or resistance-associated genes were identified in the cluster. True if present, otherwise false.

transport_genes_present.descr: Indicates whether transporter/export genes are present in the cluster. True if present, otherwise false.

regulatory_genes_present.descr: Indicates whether regulatory genes are present in the cluster. True if present, otherwise false.

gene_annotation_method.descr: Method/software used for gene-level functional annotation. Example values: 'Prokka', 'eggNOG-mapper', 'BLAST', 'InterProScan'.

gene_annotation_version.descr: Version of the annotation tool or pipeline used.

protein_domains_detected.descr: Detected functional protein domains relevant to biosynthesis, recorded as a standardized or delimiter-separated string. Example: 'A-domain; KS-domain; ACP-domain'.

predicted_precursor_peptide.descr: Predicted precursor peptide sequence for ribosomally synthesized clusters, if applicable.

predicted_substrate_specificity.descr: Predicted substrate specificity for adenylation, acyltransferase, or related domains. Example: 'valine', 'malonyl-CoA'.

compound_id.descr: Unique identifier for the chemically characterized antibiotic compound associated with the cluster.

compound_name.descr: Common, provisional, or IUPAC-derived name of the antibiotic compound. Example: 'newamycin A'.

compound_class.descr: Chemical class of the antibiotic compound. Example values: 'polyketide', 'nonribosomal peptide', 'glycopeptide', 'lipopeptide', 'terpene-derived'.

compound_formula.descr: Molecular formula of the characterized compound, if determined. Example: 'C45H72N8O12'.

compound_monoisotopic_mass.descr: Monoisotopic mass of the compound in Daltons (Da).

compound_mz.descr: Observed mass-to-charge ratio (m/z) for the compound under the reported ionization condition.

compound_rt_min.descr: Chromatographic retention time of the compound in minutes, if applicable.

compound_purity_percent.descr: Estimated purity of the isolated compound as a percentage.

compound_structure_elucidation_method.descr: Methods used to elucidate compound structure. Example values: 'NMR', 'MS/MS', 'X-ray crystallography', 'chemical derivatization'.

compound_is_novel.descr: Indicates whether the compound is considered novel relative to known antibiotics. True if novel, otherwise false.

compound_novelty_basis.descr: Basis for novelty claim. Example values: 'new scaffold', 'new analog', 'new stereochemistry', 'new producer'.

antibiotic_activity_assay.descr: Assay used to assess antibiotic activity. Example: 'broth microdilution', 'agar diffusion', 'MIC panel'.

target_organism.descr: Indicator organism or pathogen tested in antibiotic activity assays. Example: 'Staphylococcus aureus', 'Escherichia coli'.

activity_outcome.descr: Outcome of the antibiotic assay. Example values: 'active', 'inactive', 'weakly active', 'not tested'.

mic_value.descr: Minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) value in the reported unit, if measured.

mic_unit.descr: Unit used for the MIC value. Example values: 'ug/mL', 'uM'.

zone_of_inhibition_mm.descr: Diameter of inhibition zone in millimeters, if measured in diffusion assays.

bioactivity_spectrum.descr: Summary of antibacterial spectrum. Example values: 'Gram-positive only', 'broad-spectrum', 'selective for actinomycetes'.

production_condition.descr: Culture medium or induction condition used to observe compound production. Example: 'ISP2 broth', 'OSMAC variant 3'.

fermentation_time_h.descr: Fermentation or cultivation time in hours before extraction/analysis.

extraction_solvent.descr: Solvent used for metabolite extraction. Example values: 'ethyl acetate', 'methanol'.

analytical_platform.descr: Instrument or analytical platform used for chemical characterization. Example values: 'LC-MS', 'LC-MS/MS', 'HPLC', 'NMR'.

biosynthetic_link_evidence.descr: Evidence linking the cluster to the compound. Example values: 'correlation', 'gene knockout', 'heterologous expression', 'isotopic labeling'.

validation_status.descr: Overall validation status of the cluster-to-compound assignment. Example values: 'predicted', 'putatively linked', 'experimentally validated'.

publication_doi.descr: Digital Object Identifier of the associated publication, if available. Example: '10.1038/xxxxx'.

data_repository_accession.descr: Accession or identifier for a supporting dataset in a public repository. Example values: sequence read archive, metabolomics repository, or internal archive identifier.

record_created_date.descr: Date when this metadata record was created, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

record_updated_date.descr: Date when this metadata record was last updated, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).
